verdict.rationale: Spline is a cloud-based design tool with a desktop app, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking setting, or a way to opt out. The self-hosted export and sandboxed iframe concern deployment and code isolation, not telemetry controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
